# MediaDC

This mod adds the required and optional packages the MediaDC nextcloud app needs to work. Optional dependency Scipy is only installed on x8664 as there are no wheels available for arm64v8.

Add it to the `nextcloud` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:nextcloud-mediadc
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:nextcloud-mediadc|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/nextcloud-mediadc/
